options.text: Grants one role to one identity on an existing Key Vault, and nothing else. Use it to give an identity read access to the secrets the Abstract deployment needs. The vault must already exist in the resource group you are deploying to.

basics.name: keyVaultName
basics.label: Key Vault name
basics.toolTip: Name of the EXISTING Key Vault in this resource group. Find it with: az keyvault list -g <resource-group> --query [].name -o tsv

validations.message: 3-24 characters, must start with a letter and end with a letter or number; letters, numbers and hyphens only.

basics.name: principalId
basics.label: Principal object ID
basics.toolTip: Object ID of the service principal, user or group that receives the role. This is the object ID, NOT the application (client) ID. Find a service principal's with: az ad sp show --id <application-client-id> --query id -o tsv

basics.name: roleDefinitionId
basics.label: Role definition resource ID
basics.toolTip: Full resource ID of the role to grant, for example the built-in Key Vault Secrets User role. Find it with: az role definition list --name "Key Vault Secrets User" --query [].id -o tsv

validations.message: Supply the full role definition resource ID, starting with /subscriptions/.

basics.name: principalType
basics.label: Principal type
basics.toolTip: Set this for a freshly created identity to avoid PrincipalNotFound while the directory replicates. Leave it unspecified when the type is not known, for example a user or group you were given.
